item.title: Three insights you may have missed from theCUBE’s coverage of Okta’s Oktane event
item.description:
AI agent governance is moving identity security into the flow of work. As agents call tools, delegate tasks and act across applications, enterprises need controls that follow those actions beyond an initial login. The challenge is making those controls work across systems while preserving the business processes agents support. The limits of individual security platforms […]

item.title: Anthropic reveals Mythos 5 tried submitting malicious code to an open-source project
item.description:
Anthropic PBC’s Mythos 5 artificial intelligence model attempted to submit malicious code to a GitHub project in July. The incident occurred during an evaluation of the algorithm’s cybersecurity capabilities.
